scope: A noncircular quantifier and evidence schema, not an instantiated universal theorem or a completed parent formulation gate.

external_parameters.F: One independently fixed foundation record: language, axioms, universe levels and formation rules, models or derivations, and a validity judgement chosen before testing a process account.
external_parameters.K: One independently fixed class of constructions with objects, typed intermediate operations, substitutions, identities, proof obligations and completion modes; membership cannot depend on successful realization.
external_parameters.E: Declared physical contexts, environments and resource/uncertainty policies; not selected after observing a desired result.

root_schema: Root(F,K,E): exists P, physical binding B, and one coherent family (R_M) indexed by every F-valid M in K, such that P and B are fixed across M and every R_M preserves the declared typed stage, operation, identity, resource and completion obligations. Overlap comparisons belong to that same family and satisfy their declared coherence, rather than being independently chosen after each pairwise test.

validity.syntax: F proves a specified judgement from declared premises; no proof-discovery or decidability requirement follows.
validity.semantics: F's specified model class satisfies a judgement; this is not identified with proof derivability without an explicit soundness/completeness result.
validity.universe_policy: Levels and formation rules are part of F. Quantification over the family is metatheoretic at a declared larger level or class policy, never Type:Type. No classical/Cubical translation is supplied.
validity.noncircularity: Validity and K-membership do not depend on P, on existence of R_M, or on observed outputs. A collection of successful pilots cannot define K.

source_data.adapter_boundary: A supplied domain law is permitted in an explicitly labelled adapter. Claiming generation by P additionally requires its actual primitive derivation and preservation witnesses. Inputting a proof does not show that P discovered or natively derived it.

representation.faithfulness: Specify preserved and reflected judgements per identity kind. Complete source recovery must not be replaced by a coarse observation. Task quotients must preserve guard availability and observations for all licensed continuations; they do not by themselves realize unrestricted substitution.
representation.composition: Maps compose only at matching typed domains and source/context records. Retain witnesses and specified higher comparisons. Equal final outputs alone are not a full stagewise realization.

resources.schema: For each fixed context use a supplied ordered resource algebra with unit and sequential composition. A realization declares a monotone cost translation compatible with sequencing and guard availability; additive natural-number cost is only a test instance.
resources.finite_execution: Each claimed physically executed finite task must have independently admitted preparation, operations, environment, budget and uncertainty evidence. No uniform finite budget for all constructions or proof search is inferred.
resources.unbounded_families: A family of finite tasks with increasing budgets is not execution of an infinite task. A formal cost bound is not empirical resource calibration.

infinite_representation.requirements: Declare the mode, topology or error relation, admissible operations and limit/continuation preservation. A name alone does not realize the object's operations; separate symbolic naming from effective approximation and from physical execution.
infinite_representation.effectivity: If an effective approximation procedure is claimed, supply it and its error/control theorem. Semantic existence alone supplies no algorithm. Noncomputable or non-finitely-presented objects in K cannot be silently removed because a chosen P fails to realize them.
infinite_representation.physical_infinity: No physical completion of arbitrary infinite constructions in finite time is asserted. Infinite representation is a mathematical/completion obligation plus separately admitted finite experimental accesses.

physical_account.definition: A source with typed primitive preparations, evolutions, interactions and observations, bound to the declared lowest-level physical description by independent evidence on domains, units, resources and uncertainties. Calling a simulator fundamental is not such evidence.
